mapper.select: SELECT i.owner_id,i.id AS item_id,v.id AS version_id,v.title, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.capturedOn')),'null') AS captured_on, i.revision AS item_revision,i.status,i.current_version_id,i.source_generation, JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.requirements') AS requirements_json FROM preparation_item i JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=#{versionId} WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{itemId} AND i.kind='TARGET'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_topic WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id})
